name: Marta Wisniewska
headline: Data Engineer
summary: Data Engineer with 5 years of experience building and maintaining scalable data pipelines on GCP. Skilled in Python, SQL, and Airflow orchestration, with a strong focus on data quality and reliable ETL processes for analytics teams.

responsibilities: Design and maintain ETL pipelines using Airflow and Python for ingesting data from multiple sources
Optimize BigQuery datasets and SQL queries to improve reporting performance
Collaborate with analytics team to define data models and ensure data quality
Migrate legacy on-premise batch jobs to GCP-based cloud infrastructure
Built and scheduled data ingestion scripts in Python for internal reporting systems
Assisted senior engineers in developing Airflow DAGs for daily data processing
Wrote SQL queries to support ad-hoc business analysis requests
Monitored pipeline failures and performed basic troubleshooting
Supported data cleaning and preparation tasks using Python and Excel
Created basic dashboards for internal stakeholders
Assisted in documenting data sources and transformation logic
